question: The proxy gates cost tokens and rejection rounds. Do the artifacts they approve come out better?

ops.text:
## Ablation arm: auto-advance gates

For this run only, advance every phase gate without a Product Owner Proxy verdict. Record the advance on BOARD.md as usual.

note: Safety-critical gates (the security override, the Never Building check) are NOT removed here — they are insurance, exempt from a delete verdict (§7.10), and removing them would make the arm a measurement of recklessness rather than of gate value.
